negative_findings: Earlier kernel version could replay a cached observation after revoke; revalidation-before-replay fixed this.
Earlier receipt recomputed current authority; receipts now preserve authorization observed at execution time.
Earlier approval was run-scoped; approval is now request/idempotency-key scoped.
Earlier deny rules were ignored; explicit deny now has precedence.
limitations: The local subprocess executor is not an OS sandbox.
Relation state is in-memory in v0.1 and is not yet durable.
Policy rules are exact-match rules; no wildcard or hierarchy semantics are implemented yet.
No external OSS runtime is required or imported by this primitive.
